lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 13 distinct high-contrast white vertical stripes traversing the torso; spacing is approximately uniform across the mid-section, narrowing significantly at the posterior terminus.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed at the ventral terminus of the 4th anterior stripe; minor merging of topological segments at the lower 12th and 13th stripes near the haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Stripes 5, 6, 7, and 8 terminate mid-flank, transitioning into isolated white blobs before reaching the ventral midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 3 distinct spots on the upper hind haunch; a secondary, denser grouping of 5 spots located at the junction of the lower flank and posterior limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment of three circular blobs on the lower mid-flank, forming a semi-connected geometric line parallel to the belly.

other_distinctive_markers: Two high-contrast white spots on the lateral face (sub-orbital and muzzle regions); a prominent white crescent-shaped patch visible at the base of the ventral neck.
